svg.title: Task Track + Handoff — how the two halves share one goal anchor
svg.desc: Three lanes — within a session (Task Track), the seam (wrap to handoff doc), and the next session (resume). A red thread carries the MAIN goal anchor straight across the seam and loops back to repeat.
svg.text: Don't lose the thread — within a session, or between them. The ⭐️ MAIN is the shared anchor.
⭐️ MAIN goal anchor 🌶️ critical 🍏 temp this session 🍋 logged / recurred
red path = the thread (the MAIN travels it) · dashed loop = the cycle repeats next session
